key_concepts: Energy can be transformed from one form to another
A dropped ball converts gravitational potential energy into kinetic energy as it falls
On impact, some kinetic energy changes into sound, heat, or deformation, so rebound height
Different balls rebound to different heights because of differences in material properties
In a roller coaster, gravitational potential energy is greatest at the top of a hill
As a marble moves down a ramp, potential energy is converted into kinetic energy
Mechanical energy is conserved only when friction is absent
With friction, mechanical energy is transformed into other forms such as heat and sound
Total energy along a track includes potential, kinetic, and dissipated forms
A waterwheel transforms the energy of falling water into rotational motion
Adding weight to a waterwheel changes its rate of rotation
